required_documents.name: SF-424 Application for Federal Assistance
required_documents.details: Standard federal application form submitted through Grants.gov workspace.

required_documents.name: 5-Year UCEDD Core Strategic Plan and Narrative
required_documents.details: Five-year comprehensive work plan addressing all 4 statutory core functions: (1) interdisciplinary pre-service preparation, (2) community services/training, (3) research, and (4) information dissemination.

required_documents.name: University Affiliation and Designated UCEDD Verification
required_documents.details: Documentation of university designation and core grant status under Section 151(a) of the Developmental Disabilities Act (awarded FY 2022 core funds).

required_documents.name: Consumer Advisory Committee (CAC) Structure and Membership Roster
required_documents.details: Roster showing majority participation of individuals with developmental disabilities and family members pursuant to DD Act requirements.

required_documents.name: SF-424A Multi-Year Budget and Non-Federal Matching Commitment
required_documents.details: Detailed 5-year budget up to ,042 annual federal share and documentation of 25% non-federal match (10% in poverty areas).

required_documents.name: SAM.gov Active UEI and Grants.gov Registration
required_documents.details: Active Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) on SAM.gov.

eligibility.summary: Only designated University Centers for Excellence in Developmental Disabilities (UCEDD) awarded five-year core funds in FY 2022 under DD Act Section 151(a). In North Carolina, the designated UCEDD is the Carolina Institute for Developmental Disabilities (CIDD) at UNC Chapel Hill.

cost_share.details: 25% non-federal match required under DD Act Section 156 (10% non-federal match for projects in designated poverty areas).

review_criteria.criterion: Implementation of Four Core Statutory Functions (Education, Community Services, Research, Dissemination)
Consumer Advisory Committee Engagement and Self-Advocate Leadership
Alignment with State Developmental Disabilities Council and Protection & Advocacy Agency

funded_activities.activity: Interdisciplinary pre-service preparation and continuing education of students and professionals in developmental disabilities.
Community services, technical assistance, model demonstrations, and training across education, healthcare, housing, and employment.
Applied research and public dissemination of evidence-based practices enhancing independence of individuals with developmental disabilities.

submission_limits: Limited competition: only up to 42 entities designated as UCEDD core grantees nationwide.
important_notes: Five-year core grants with annual funding ceiling of ,042.
In North Carolina, the eligible applicant is CIDD at UNC Chapel Hill in partnership with state agencies.
